package.author: Marco Gomiero
package.description: FeedFlow is a minimalistic RSS Reader available on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux. Built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI.

en-US.author: Marco Gomiero
en-US.description: FeedFlow is a minimalistic RSS Reader available on Android, iOS, macOS, Windows and Linux. Built with Kotlin Multiplatform, Jetpack Compose and SwiftUI.
en-US.name: FeedFlow
en-US.releaseNotes:
• Sites and apps that offer a FeedFlow or feed:// link can open the add-feed window with the address filled in
• The article list follows along when you move to the next or previous article in the reader
• Search the Settings window to find any option quickly
• Refreshing keeps your open article and your place in the list
• The background sync setting is now called Refresh while open
• Find answers in the new FAQ, under About
• Disconnecting an account now asks first and warns which data will be removed
• Categories with the same name are merged during cloud sync instead of stopping it
• Screen readers now announce whether an article is unread or bookmarked
• Very long code blocks in the reader show as plain text instead of failing to display
• Images that fail to load and have no description show an Open image link
• FeedFlow is now available in Romanian and Indonesian
